response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, technically versatile senior/staff-level individual contributor with real developer-tooling experience (test runners, CI/CD, GitLab administration, MCP tooling) and some mobile background, but the role is fundamentally a people-management position and his entire 15+ year career history shows no formal people-management or direct-report responsibility — every title is an IC role (Developer, Senior/Staff Developer, Founder). This is a hard gap against the role's core requirement of 2+ years people leadership.
strengths: Deep, hands-on experience building developer tools (test frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, GitLab/build infrastructure)
Broad technical range spanning web, mobile, embedded, and systems programming, including relevant mobile (iOS/Apple TV) work
Track record of knowledge-sharing via workshops, conference talks, and courses, showing mentoring inclination
concerns: No evidence of formal people management or direct reports anywhere in 15+ year career
All titles are individual-contributor (Developer/Staff/Senior), with no team-lead or managerial scope indicated
No demonstrated experience leading organizational change or owning a strategic multi-team roadmap

key_factors.factor: Strong developer tooling / build & test infrastructure background
No formal leadership/management titles despite seniority
